tiers.0: Default-safe local or permissively licensed source. Prefer these first.
tiers.1: Official vendor source with use or trademark terms. Use only for the exact product or service represented.
tiers.2: Per-asset or attribution-sensitive source. Verify the selected asset and record the required credit before use.

entries.title: Bundled draw.io shape index
entries.default_action: Run scripts/shapesearch.py and use the exact returned style and aspect ratio.
entries.compatibility: Native editable draw.io shapes; works offline.

entries.title: diagrams.net public custom libraries directory
entries.license: Repository Apache-2.0; individual upstream asset license is listed per library and still governs
entries.default_action: Choose a specific listed library, verify its per-library license, then load its raw XML URL in draw.io.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom libraries; load with File > Open Library from URL or clibs=U<encoded-url>.

entries.title: diagrams.net technical template building blocks
entries.default_action: Use as a layout fragment or composition reference; restyle it to the figure contract.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom library.

entries.title: Google Material Symbols for draw.io
entries.default_action: Use one consistent outlined icon family for generic actions or devices; avoid brand substitution.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom library; recolorable.

entries.title: Heroicons for draw.io
entries.default_action: Use for sparse interface, state, and action symbols when Material Symbols do not fit.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom library; outline and solid variants.

entries.title: IBM Carbon icons for draw.io
entries.default_action: Use for data, compute, AI, quantum, and observability concepts with one consistent family.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom library; recolorable.

entries.title: Tabler Icons
entries.default_action: Default external SVG family for restrained engineering figures. Search and vendor selected 24x24 outline icons with scripts/tablericons.py, then run validate_svg_assets.py and preserve viewBox/aspect.
entries.compatibility: Self-contained SVG imports as vector image cells; scripts/tablericons.py uses the official GitHub tree/raw paths and copies the MIT notice beside selected files.

entries.title: Iconoir
entries.default_action: Use as a coherent 24x24 outline alternative when its silhouettes match better than Tabler; never mix both in one repeated row.
entries.compatibility: SVG imports as vector image cells; run validate_svg_assets.py before embedding.

entries.title: Phosphor Icons Core
entries.default_action: Choose one Phosphor weight for the complete figure or panel; do not mix thin, regular, bold, fill, and duotone variants.
entries.compatibility: Raw SVG assets; run validate_svg_assets.py and preserve intrinsic aspect.

entries.title: Koboyo hand-drawn icons
entries.license: Koboyo custom icon license; broad personal/commercial use, no attribution, redistribution and competing-library restrictions
entries.default_action: Opt-in only when the user explicitly requests a hand-drawn/organic family or the supplied style reference requires it. Do not spend metered MCP retrieval when Tabler passes; record selected icons and do not redistribute a substantial subset.
entries.compatibility: Search and retrieve through Koboyo MCP or use selected SVGs; run validate_svg_assets.py before draw.io embedding.

entries.title: Flaticon (non-default commercial library)
entries.license: Not open source; free use generally requires attribution and resource redistribution/sublicensing is restricted
entries.default_action: Do not use as a default paper-figure source. Prefer MIT families; use only after verifying the exact asset and account/license terms and recording attribution.
entries.compatibility: SVG may import, but licensing and attribution must be cleared per use.

entries.title: Health Icons for draw.io
entries.default_action: Use for public-health and clinical concepts; choose either outline or filled style, never both.
entries.compatibility: Native draw.io custom library; recolorable.

entries.title: Microsoft featured Visio templates and diagrams
entries.default_action: Use the gallery to select a layout archetype; redraw and restyle scientific content instead of embedding a whole template.
entries.compatibility: .vsdx can be imported through online draw.io conversion; .vstx is treated as a Visio-only layout reference unless converted separately.

entries.title: Microsoft Visio computer block diagram template
entries.default_action: Use only as a block-diagram composition reference; replace all content with the paper's semantic graph.
entries.compatibility: Online draw.io can import .vsdx; conversion may not preserve every Visio detail.

entries.title: Microsoft Visio basic flowchart template
entries.default_action: Use as a top-down process or hierarchy layout reference; recreate the figure with native draw.io primitives.
entries.compatibility: Visio template; do not assume direct draw.io import for .vstx.

entries.title: Microsoft 365 architecture icons, Visio templates, and stencils
entries.license: Permitted by Microsoft for architecture diagrams, training materials, and documentation; other rights reserved
entries.default_action: Use only for exact Microsoft 365 architecture concepts and record the pack version/source in asset-ledger.md.
entries.compatibility: Use SVG directly as a vector image, or convert compatible legacy .vss stencils via vss.draw.io. Do not assume .vssx conversion.

entries.title: Official Azure architecture icons
entries.license: Permitted by Microsoft for architecture diagrams, training materials, and documentation; other rights reserved
entries.default_action: Use only for the exact Azure service represented; keep the service name adjacent and do not crop, rotate, or distort the icon.
entries.compatibility: General-purpose SVG, not a Visio stencil; import as a vector image.

entries.title: Official AWS architecture icons
entries.license: AWS architecture icon and trademark terms
entries.default_action: Use only for the exact AWS service represented and prefer the current quarterly icon package over legacy third-party copies.
entries.compatibility: SVG and PNG can be imported; draw.io also has native AWS shapes in the bundled index.

entries.title: BioIcons scientific SVG library and draw.io extension
entries.license: Mixed per asset: CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, MIT, and others
entries.default_action: Select an individual asset, verify its license and creator, and copy the exact attribution into asset-ledger.md before use.
entries.compatibility: SVG import or BioIcons draw.io extension; external SVG remains a vector image rather than editable model primitives.

entries.title: SciDraw scientific illustration library
entries.default_action: Prefer SVG; record title, creator, asset URL, modifications, and CC BY 4.0 credit before use.
entries.compatibility: SVG can be imported as a vector image; raster assets are allowed only in input/context regions.

entries.title: Servier Medical Art
entries.default_action: Use only for anatomy, physiology, pathology, or treatment concepts and include Servier's recommended credit.
entries.compatibility: SVG can be imported as a vector image; preserve scientific accuracy and attribution.
